recommendations: Configure FRONTEND_ORIGIN on production backend environment (e.g. Render/Railway) matching deployed frontend URL (e.g. Vercel).
Set VITE_API_BASE_URL on production frontend build environment pointing to the deployed backend URL.
For production Linux backend execution, use a production WSGI server (e.g. gunicorn -w 4 -b 0.0.0.0:$PORT backend.app:app).
Monitor CricAPI v1 daily hit quota (100 hits/day on free tier) and keep LIVE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS at 30 seconds.
